arrivalEssentials: Complete the SG Arrival Card before landing if you have not already done it.
Decide early between MRT and taxi or Grab depending on your bags and arrival time.
Keep a small amount of SGD or a working card ready for food, train fares, and backups.
If you need mobile data immediately, arrange an eSIM or airport SIM before leaving arrivals.

options.bestFor: Budget-conscious solo travellers with light luggage
options.notes: Take the Changi Airport branch line and change at Tanah Merah for the city.

options.bestFor: Late arrivals, meetings straight from the airport, or extra bags
options.notes: Airport, late-night, and peak surcharges can push the fare up.

options.bestFor: Hotel drop-off without arranging a private car
options.notes: Useful when your hotel participates and you want a middle ground between MRT and taxi.

entryRequirements.passportValidity: Aim for at least 6 months validity from your date of entry.
entryRequirements.visaSummary: Australian passport holders generally do not need a visa for short social or business visits, but final permission to enter is decided on arrival.
entryRequirements.arrivalCardOrDeclaration: Submit the SG Arrival Card before arriving in Singapore; it is not a visa.
entryRequirements.officialSourceNote: Check Singapore ICA guidance and the SG Arrival Card page before travel.
importantNotes: Keep proof of onward travel and accommodation handy in case it is requested.
Entry conditions can change quickly if health or immigration rules are updated.

handyPhrases.context: English is widely spoken, but a warm multilingual greeting can still land well.
Useful in hawker centres, taxis, and small shops.
Singlish-style phrasing is common and easily understood.

businessEtiquette.summary: Singapore business culture usually values punctuality, clarity, and a polished, low-drama style.
tips: Arrive a few minutes early rather than exactly on time.
Exchange business cards respectfully and take a moment to look at the card before putting it away.
Keep initial meetings concise, prepared, and data-backed.

foodAndPracticalities.tapWater: Tap water is generally safe to drink.
foodAndPracticalities.tipping: Tipping is not usually expected because many venues already add service charges.
foodAndPracticalities.dietaryNotes: Vegetarian, halal, and no-pork options are common, especially in larger food courts and malls.
foodAndPracticalities.commonFoodTips: Hawker centres are excellent for quick, affordable meals; some stalls are cashless while others still prefer cash.
usefulPhrases: Can I get this without pork?

moneyAndPayments.cardAcceptance: Cards are widely accepted in hotels, malls, and many restaurants.
moneyAndPayments.cashNotes: Keep a little cash for older hawker stalls, small shops, or backup transport situations.
moneyAndPayments.tipping: Not usually expected beyond rounding up in casual situations.
roughCostExamples: Coffee at a hawker centre: about SGD 1.50 to 3
Simple hawker meal: about SGD 5 to 10
Taxi from Changi to central areas: about SGD 25 to 45

localTransportApps.name: Grab
localTransportApps.useCase: Ride-hailing, food delivery, and cashless local transport backup
localTransportApps.notes: Often the easiest option after landing if you do not want to figure out MRT changes immediately.

localTransportApps.name: Citymapper
localTransportApps.notes: Helpful for combining MRT and walking in central areas.

emergencyNumbers.label: Police, ambulance, and fire
notes: Use for urgent emergencies requiring immediate help.
For non-urgent medical help, check local clinic or hospital contact options separately.

disclaimer: Sample briefing only. Entry rules, health requirements, and transport conditions can change; always confirm current details with official sources before you travel.
